div.div: * Guest captive portal exception: Guest clients may reach the Cloud Key on TCP 8880 before the broader internal-network block is evaluated.

div.div:
Legend
Green = explicitly permitted initiation
Red = blocked initiation
Gray = same-zone / not meaningfully represented as an inter-VLAN firewall decision
